mentions.name: Unified MCP server (aci)
mentions.description: A unified MCP server that lets AI agents search and use a large number of tools through just two meta tools: one to search available tools and one to execute a tool. For a task like sending an email, the LLM uses the search meta tool to find Gmail-related tools in the backend, then uses the execute meta tool to run the returned tool.
mentions.problem: Adding each MCP server directly doesn't scale: configuring many servers for an agent's tools confuses the LLM and tool calling accuracy starts to drop.
mentions.audience: Developers building AI agents that need to use many tools
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an unified MCP server that can search and use a large number of tools. The current way of using MCP server (adding each MCP server directly) simply doesn't scale.
